limitations: All candidate/baseline ratios remain unqualified diagnostic comparisons; three repeat failures prevent affected-catalog performance acceptance.
The baseline is earlier integrated main, not the published 9.0.0 release.
Later combined main includes shared ordinary Classic encoding and is not source-identical to the measured candidate.
All caller fixtures and workload witnesses match, and the complete measured fault sequences match across phases; neither establishes codec-internal owners, physical pages or cache equivalence.
Calling-thread service includes the complete original operation window and is not exclusive kernel or API cycles.
Parent-window guest CPU, memory and I/O snapshots cannot identify an individual API sample or prove physical host/frequency/cache isolation.
No original failure, count, workload, threshold, observer or frozen source was modified; no unchanged campaign was rerun to select passing data.
